title: Registered ({count}/{max})

state.missedCheckIn: out of bracket, not checked in

add.title: Register a member
add.hint: During check-in, anyone you register is checked in right away.
add.full: No spots left. Increase the spots under Edit to register more players.
add.noCandidates: All community members are already registered.

removeConfirm: Remove {name} from the tournament? The spot opens up, and {name} can register again.
withdrawConfirm: Mark {name} as withdrawn? Every match for {name}, now or later, becomes a walkover for the opponent. This can't be undone.

registration.withdrawConfirm: Cancel your registration? The spot opens up for someone else.
registration.inviteOnly: Registration is by invite link or through the organizers only.
registration.withdrawConfirmInviteOnly: Cancel your registration? The spot opens up, and to rejoin you'll need the registration link or the organizers.

situation.title: Your status
situation.missed_check_in: Out of bracket, not checked in
situation.range: {from, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}}–{to, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}}
situation.tie_pending: Tied for {place}, the organizers will decide

checkIn.opensAt: Check-in opens <date></date>. Anyone who doesn't check in is left out of the bracket.
checkIn.open: Check-in is open. Check in to confirm your attendance and join the bracket.
checkIn.unmarkConfirm: Unmark check-in for {name}? Without check-in, {name} is left out of the bracket if the tournament starts this way.

seeding.title: Seeding: {count} of {total} registered enter
seeding.what: Put the strongest at the top. In the first round, #1 faces the last seed, #2 faces the second-to-last, and so on. #1 and #2 can only meet in the final. If there aren't enough players to fill the bracket, the top seeds get a bye in the first round.
seeding.hint: Type a position or use the arrows to move someone. Anyone who joins later goes to the end.
seeding.empty: No one eligible yet. Only players who check in are included.
seeding.noneSeeded: This seeding doesn't count yet. If you don't save it, the seeding is drawn when the tournament starts.
seeding.shuffleConfirm: Shuffling now discards the seeding you changed. Continue?
seeding.closed: Seeding is set during check-in (or, in a tournament without check-in, while registration is open), before the tournament starts.

summary.title: Seeding
summary.random: No seeding set. It is drawn when the tournament starts.
summary.partial: The seeding covers only some registered players. Anyone who joined later goes to the end.
summary.unavailable: Couldn't load the seeding right now. Reload the page.
summary.started: The seeding used is on the Registered tab.
summary.atCheckIn: Seeding is set during check-in, with players who confirmed attendance.
summary.atRegistration: Seeding is set after publishing, while registration is open.
summary.countTeams: {count, plural, =0 {No teams enter} one {# team enters} other {# teams enter}} the bracket.
summary.emptyTeams: No complete teams yet. Form teams first.

seeding.titleTeams: Seeding: {count, plural, one {# team enters} other {# teams enter}}
seeding.emptyTeams: No complete teams yet. Form teams first.
seeding.emptyTeamsCheckIn: No team is complete with everyone checked in yet. Form teams first.
seeding.teamsLeftOut: {count, plural, one {# incomplete team is left out of the seeding} other {# incomplete teams are left out of the seeding}}. The tournament can only start without incomplete teams.
seeding.teamsLeftOutCheckIn: {count, plural, one {# team that is incomplete or has someone not checked in is left out of the seeding} other {# teams that are incomplete or have someone not checked in are left out of the seeding}}. The tournament can only start without them.
